plugin.name: ESP version (recommended)
plugin.description: The full mod: a light plugin (ESL-flagged, it takes no load-order slot) that adds the Skyforge Steel armour set, mace, warhammer, bow and arrows, all made only at the Skyforge, and gives vanilla's five Skyforge Steel weapons our look.

plugin.name: No ESP - SkyPatcher
plugin.description: No plugin, and much less: REQUIRES SkyPatcher (https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/106659), which edits existing records at game start but cannot add new ones. So this option ONLY gives vanilla's five Skyforge Steel weapons (sword, dagger, greatsword, battleaxe, war axe) our look; their stats, names and how you get them stay vanilla. NOT included: the armour set, the mace, warhammer, bow and arrows, and every recipe at the Skyforge - those are new items and need the ESP version.

plugin.name: CBBE 3BA - BodySlide files
plugin.description: Slider sets and shape data to build the female set to your CBBE 3BA preset in BodySlide (no physics), from Xonek's Legacy of Ysgramor - 3BA Bodyslide (permissions as Legacy of Ysgramor's), under the group "Nordic Skyforged - CBBE 3BA". Nothing is prebuilt: build them once in BodySlide.
